S.FORM: == 世界自由日O lihadayay lomi'ad no hekal == O lihadalay lomi'ad no hekal a sanay a sowal i, i 'ayaw a sowal i olanan tora 123lihadayay lomi'ad saan, nawhani itini i sakacecay a folad to 23 a lomi'adanan ami palowad, o tatapangan haw i, ora pikiningan tora Conghoamingko i tira i 1954 .01.23 a lomi'ad a folad ato mihecaan, to kafafolaw itini i Koliya a Ciwkoku ato Padaka Amilika maraholiway a holam tayniay i Taywan tora miihangay to Kiwsanto a tamdaw, hapapolong to kakokoka ami kining toya lomi'ad, sanaw "o lihadayay lomi'ad no hekal" haan. O pinangan nira.背景 Itini i 1950.6 folad a mihecaan, toya misalingato ama fafolaw kola Koliya a kanatar, saka 10 a folad(10月) mikihatiaay ko Ciwkoko holam a patayla to 30 polo' a sofitay ami folaw, yasato toya no kapapolongan a sofitay i, Caay pakafilo ami folaw sanaw talalikol to, 11/26 toya folad a lomi'ad i, tangasa i 12 a folad, naitini i Pinlang a talalikol, 1951.10 a folad toya mihecaan, itini i Panmentien hananay ama sasowasowal a patelep to kakafolaw. Yasato toya malepelay no kapapolongan a kanatal a sofitay i, milongoc ko Ciwkoku to sakapatatikol to polong sofitay a patikol ami nokay, ano caay to kakayhi ano makayhiay to, nikaolila caay paca'of ko kapapolongan a kakukoka, sanaw itini i 1952 a mihecaan to saka tosa a folad i, o kasasowasowal no polongan a kanatal a sofitay, caay pihayda to longoc no Ciwkoku , oya-malepelay no sakapapolongan a kanatal a sofitay i pakaalaay to 17 a ^emangan, ilaay ko 10 a ^emangan i, caay ka kayhi ami nokay a patalalikol, itini i tosaay a ^emangan i, caay ka pacici aminokay i, pakaalaay to cecay a ^emang ira ko 'enem a 'esingan, opolong omaleplay a sofitay no Ciwkuko i ma^deng 173,700 tamdawan, o so'linay a tada sofitay nara i 21,300 a tamdawan, o sa'ayaway a sofitay i 600 a tamdawan, dodosato to faleday i 30 a tamdawan, midodo sato faled i 5 a tamdawan, safaleday to i 1 a tamdawan, itiniay i Ciciy hananay a niyalo' ama lofo. 1953.6 a folad to mihecan, itiniay i Fosan hananay no Koliya a niyalo' tomalofoay a sofitay to 14,200 a tamdawan i, pasadak to codad ami ihang to Kiwsanto , milogoc tosaka sadakaw mangalay a tayni i Taywan ami comod i Conghaminko a sofitay, likorsato mahelek tokasasowal, calasato ko citodongay, nikaolira o Into a kanatal koci-todongay ami hapinang ami laheci to demak. Halateng sakola Ciwkokay a tamdaw i, hai:to o Intocing ko citodongay ami hapinang to demak, nikaolira, ora toya no kapolongan asa'opo to lomaloma a kanatal koci todongay ami hapinang ato misakilac to demak, todongay toma'osiay to Kiwsanto osanay a demak, itini i kala-loodlood no kiwsanto ato Conghoaminko haw i, so'ling adihayay koma'osiay ami nokay a tayra i Congkou , sanaw magalay cangra a tayra i Taywan o sanay, likosato o taniay i Taywan toya mihecaan i polong sofitay 14,235 a tamdawan, ominokayay sato a tayla i Congkou a tamdaw i, sowalsa iraay ko makali'angay ato mapadesay, alatek likolsato iraay ko kinapatayay saan ko tengil. O tayniay i Taywan a sofitay i, adihay komi padangay i cangraan, ano nailomaay a kanatal a sa'opo ato icowacowaay i, mahecaday to ko faloco' ami hamham i cangraan, o tayniay i Taywan amaraholiway i, toloay ama tatoortoor a tangasa i Kilong osa'ayaway i, itiniay i 1954.01.23 a tangasa, toyasa alomi'ad 'alomanay a tamdaw tayla i Kilong ami hamham tokatangasa nangra, dodosato taniay haca i Tayhok ami pahapinang to olah nangra ami hamham, mafana' toko icowacowaay a karo niyaro' i, polong sato ami kingking tota kingkingan, iraay ko tosa polo' ira ko tolo ami kingking to ta kingkingan, sanaw itiyaay ami salingato ami pahapingang totodongay itira i sakacecay a folad to tosa polo' ira ko tolo a lomi'adan to pikining tora 123kahodayan hananay a lomi'ad, tosa pikiningaw tora minokayay a mara holiway nai Koliya , itiyaay ami longoc to polong no hekal ami kihatiya ami kining to lipahak no faloco', itini sato i 1954 amihecaan i, itini sato i Pongfo Makong ami palowad to lihadayay hananay a talo'an. Olanan sanay a Conghawminko a sayfo i, misanga' tora "123lihadayay lomi'ad" hananay topi kining nangra toka pasadak to sofitay nai Koliya , dodosato taniay i Tayko Mongko ami palowad tohatiniay a demak, olanan sato tora panokayay nai Koliya a sofitay a tamdaw i, likor sato ora sayfo sato no Taywan kocitodongay ami dipod to'orip nangra, irako talaay i pitilidan ami tiliday, iraay ko tayraay i sofitay ama lahitay, ato tayraay i katayalan ama tayal. Salikolay to nawhani halafin to awaay ko fodfod ato lawlaw to kanatal, caay to kamatiya i'ayaw ami kining tora lomi'ad, malasawad toko kasasi'adad to i Tayliokay a kanatal, ora sato tora Kiwsato hananay i, hato o mamalasawad to, sanaw ora sa to pikining tora "123 lahodayay lomi'ad" hananay a demak i, itini i 1993 amihecaan mifalic to a pala ono "hekalan a lihadayay hananay a lomi'ad". Satohaw i o i Taywanay a nano malaholiway taylaay to i Tayliok ama tayal ato palowad to tayal, mahemk toko i Tayliokay ami hamham, malecad tora ci Changcenghen hananay a tamdaw o hatilaay to ama hamham nangra.(Suman siwkolan 'Amis/Pancah 1/23'25) Tahapinangang 2009-02-28) (中文 ). 4. S.FORM: == 世界自由日O lihadayay lomi'ad no hekal == O lihadalay lomi'ad no hekal a sanay a sowal i, i 'ayaw a sowal i olanan tora 123lihadayay lomi'ad saan, nawhani itini i sakacecay a folad to 23 a lomi'adanan ami palowad, o tatapangan haw i, ora pikiningan tora Conghoamingko i tira i 1954 .01.23 a lomi'ad a folad ato mihecaan, to kafafolaw itini i Koliya a Ciwkoku ato Padaka Amilika maraholiway a holam tayniay i Taywan tora miihangay to Kiwsanto a tamdaw, hapapolong to kakokoka ami kining toya lomi'ad, sanaw "o lihadayay lomi'ad no hekal" haan. O pinangan nira.背景 Itini i 1950.6 folad a mihecaan, toya misalingato ama fafolaw kola Koliya a kanatar, saka 10 a folad(10月) mikihatiaay ko Ciwkoko holam a patayla to 30 polo' a sofitay ami folaw, yasato toya no kapapolongan a sofitay i, Caay pakafilo ami folaw sanaw talalikol to, 11/26 toya folad a lomi'ad i, tangasa i 12 a folad, naitini i Pinlang a talalikol, 1951.10 a folad toya mihecaan, itini i Panmentien hananay ama sasowasowal a patelep to kakafolaw. Yasato toya malepelay no kapapolongan a kanatal a sofitay i, milongoc ko Ciwkoku to sakapatatikol to polong sofitay a patikol ami nokay, ano caay to kakayhi ano makayhiay to, nikaolila caay paca'of ko kapapolongan a kakukoka, sanaw itini i 1952 a mihecaan to saka tosa a folad i, o kasasowasowal no polongan a kanatal a sofitay, caay pihayda to longoc no Ciwkoku , oya-malepelay no sakapapolongan a kanatal a sofitay i pakaalaay to 17 a ^emangan, ilaay ko 10 a ^emangan i, caay ka kayhi ami nokay a patalalikol, itini i tosaay a ^emangan i, caay ka pacici aminokay i, pakaalaay to cecay a ^emang ira ko 'enem a 'esingan, opolong omaleplay a sofitay no Ciwkuko i ma^deng 173,700 tamdawan, o so'linay a tada sofitay nara i 21,300 a tamdawan, o sa'ayaway a sofitay i 600 a tamdawan, dodosato to faleday i 30 a tamdawan, midodo sato faled i 5 a tamdawan, safaleday to i 1 a tamdawan, itiniay i Ciciy hananay a niyalo' ama lofo. 1953.6 a folad to mihecan, itiniay i Fosan hananay no Koliya a niyalo' tomalofoay a sofitay to 14,200 a tamdawan i, pasadak to codad ami ihang to Kiwsanto , milogoc tosaka sadakaw mangalay a tayni i Taywan ami comod i Conghaminko a sofitay, likorsato mahelek tokasasowal, calasato ko citodongay, nikaolira o Into a kanatal koci-todongay ami hapinang ami laheci to demak. Halateng sakola Ciwkokay a tamdaw i, hai:to o Intocing ko citodongay ami hapinang to demak, nikaolira, ora toya no kapolongan asa'opo to lomaloma a kanatal koci todongay ami hapinang ato misakilac to demak, todongay toma'osiay to Kiwsanto osanay a demak, itini i kala-loodlood no kiwsanto ato Conghoaminko haw i, so'ling adihayay koma'osiay ami nokay a tayra i Congkou , sanaw magalay cangra a tayra i Taywan o sanay, likosato o taniay i Taywan toya mihecaan i polong sofitay 14,235 a tamdawan, ominokayay sato a tayla i Congkou a tamdaw i, sowalsa iraay ko makali'angay ato mapadesay, alatek likolsato iraay ko kinapatayay saan ko tengil. O tayniay i Taywan a sofitay i, adihay komi padangay i cangraan, ano nailomaay a kanatal a sa'opo ato icowacowaay i, mahecaday to ko faloco' ami hamham i cangraan, o tayniay i Taywan amaraholiway i, toloay ama tatoortoor a tangasa i Kilong osa'ayaway i, itiniay i 1954.01.23 a tangasa, toyasa alomi'ad 'alomanay a tamdaw tayla i Kilong ami hamham tokatangasa nangra, dodosato taniay haca i Tayhok ami pahapinang to olah nangra ami hamham, mafana' toko icowacowaay a karo niyaro' i, polong sato ami kingking tota kingkingan, iraay ko tosa polo' ira ko tolo ami kingking to ta kingkingan, sanaw itiyaay ami salingato ami pahapingang totodongay itira i sakacecay a folad to tosa polo' ira ko tolo a lomi'adan to pikining tora 123kahodayan hananay a lomi'ad, tosa pikiningaw tora minokayay a mara holiway nai Koliya , itiyaay ami longoc to polong no hekal ami kihatiya ami kining to lipahak no faloco', itini sato i 1954 amihecaan i, itini sato i Pongfo Makong ami palowad to lihadayay hananay a talo'an. Olanan sanay a Conghawminko a sayfo i, misanga' tora "123lihadayay lomi'ad" hananay topi kining nangra toka pasadak to sofitay nai Koliya , dodosato taniay i Tayko Mongko ami palowad tohatiniay a demak, olanan sato tora panokayay nai Koliya a sofitay a tamdaw i, likor sato ora sayfo sato no Taywan kocitodongay ami dipod to'orip nangra, irako talaay i pitilidan ami tiliday, iraay ko tayraay i sofitay ama lahitay, ato tayraay i katayalan ama tayal. Salikolay to nawhani halafin to awaay ko fodfod ato lawlaw to kanatal, caay to kamatiya i'ayaw ami kining tora lomi'ad, malasawad toko kasasi'adad to i Tayliokay a kanatal, ora sato tora Kiwsato hananay i, hato o mamalasawad to, sanaw ora sa to pikining tora "123 lahodayay lomi'ad" hananay a demak i, itini i 1993 amihecaan mifalic to a pala ono "hekalan a lihadayay hananay a lomi'ad". Satohaw i o i Taywanay a nano malaholiway taylaay to i Tayliok ama tayal ato palowad to tayal, mahemk toko i Tayliokay ami hamham, malecad tora ci Changcenghen hananay a tamdaw o hatilaay to ama hamham nangra.(Suman siwkolan 'Amis/Pancah 1/23'25) Tahapinangang 2009-02-28) (中文 ). 4.
